title: Many readers, one writer

blocks.text: When reads far outnumber writes, the page recommends a `ReentrantReadWriteLock`: any number of threads may hold its **read lock** together, while its **write lock** is exclusive and shuts readers out. The course's `ReadWriteLockUsage` adds a warning: a thread that holds the read lock can **not** upgrade to the write lock; asking for it while still reading waits for ever, since the writer waits for every reader to leave, itself included.
Write `Catalog`, a `String` to `String` map guarded by one `ReentrantReadWriteLock`:

items: `String lookup(String key, Runnable whileReading)` reads under the **read** lock, and calls `whileReading.run()` while holding it.
`void publish(String key, String value, Runnable whileWriting)` writes under the **write** lock, and calls `whileWriting.run()` while holding it (after storing the value).

`String lookupOrLoad(String key, Function<String, String> loader)` returns the stored value; on a miss it calls `loader` **while holding the write lock**, stores the result and returns it, so a later call finds the value without loading again. It must **not** ask for the write lock while it holds the read lock. (Once it has the write lock, look again before loading: another thread may have loaded the key in between.)

blocks.text: The two `Runnable`s let the tests see who holds what; pass them `() -> {}` in your own code.

rows: two threads call `lookup` at the same time
both hold the read lock together
another thread calls `lookup("k", nop)` while `publish("k", "new", hook)` is in its hook
`"K"` both times; only the first loader ran

cases.says: A published value is found by lookup, and a missing key gives null.
Two lookups can hold the read lock at the same time.
A lookup that starts while a publish holds the write lock waits, and then sees the new value.
A miss in lookupOrLoad loads the value once and stores it, without deadlocking on its own read lock.
whileWriting runs after the value is stored: a lookup made from the hook already sees it.
While whileReading runs, a writer on another thread waits for the read lock to be released.
lookupOrLoad calls the loader while it holds the write lock, so a reader on another thread waits until the value is stored.

concepts: A thread holding the read lock cannot upgrade to the write lock; it must release the read lock before asking for the write lock.
A ReentrantReadWriteLock lets many readers hold the read lock together while the write lock is exclusive of readers and writers.
